title.zh: 规定南甘马粦省更切合需要的科学教育，为此修订第 8304 号共和国法（即将 San Rafael 国立高中改设为 San Rafael 国立科学高中并拨款的法案）的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for a More Responsive Science Education in the Province of Camarines Sur, Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 8304 Entitled "An Act Converting the San Rafael National High School in the Municipality of Tigaon, Province of Camarines Sur, Into a Science High School to Be Known as the San Rafael National Science High School Campus, and Appropriating Funds Therefor"

completenessNote: 全文，共 16 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8619_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 19 条，缺 11、12、13、14、15、17）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 1、3、8 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 8304 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The San Rafael National High School in the Municipality of Tigaon, Province of Camarines Sur, is hereby converted into a science high school to be known as the Philippine Science High School-Camarines Sur Campus, hereinafter referred to as the PSHS-CSC, under the supervision of the Department of Science and Technology."
The name "San Rafael National Science High School" referred to under this Act shall be amended to read as the "Philippine Science High School-Camarines Sur Campus."

Section 3 of the same Act shall be amended to read as follows:
"

Section 8 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The head of the school shall be known as the Director of PSHS-Camarines Sur Campus. He shall be appointed by the chairman subject to the approval of the Board. His compensation shall be fixed by the Board of Trustees in accordance with existing compensation laws. He shall not be removed from his position except for cause. His functions, powers and duties in addition to those specifically provided for in this Act, shall be those usually pertaining to the office of the principal of a public high school."

Section 16 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
Immediately after the approval of this Act, the Department of Science and Technology shall issue the rules and regulations necessary for the implementation of this Act for the following school year."

Section 18 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the San Rafael National Science High School are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Philippine Science High School-Camarines Sur Campus."

The same Act is hereby amended by adding a new section after Section 18 to be denominated as Section 18-A to read as follows:
"SEC. 18-A. The current first year students of San Rafael National High School shall be given the accreditation test under the PSHS transfer program. Those who will qualify shall be considered as regular students of the PSHS-CSC; otherwise, those who will not qualify together with the students in the higher year levels shall remain as regular students of the San Rafael National High School under the Department of Education, Culture and Sports until they graduate."

Section 19 of the same Act is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The amount needed to carry out the initial implementation of this Act shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the San Rafael National Science High School. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the operation and maintenance of the Philippine Science High School-Camarines Sur Campus shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act."
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
